# VietnamWorks Trending Jobs & Salary by Industry

[VietnamWorks.com](https://www.vietnamworks.com) is Vietnam's largest job board, part of Navigos Group. This actor browses its curated trending feeds, runs a paginated keyword search filtered by province, job category, seniority, employment type and posting date, or fetches full details from listing URLs. No login, cookies or API key required.

## What this actor does

- **Three modes:** `trending` (six curated homepage feeds), `search` (VietnamWorks' own paginated search API) and `byUrls` (direct listing fetch)
- **Real pagination:** `search` walks the upstream result pages (100 hits per page) until `maxItems` is reached, instead of stopping at the homepage widget's five results
- **Filters:** province/city, job category, seniority level, employment type, posted-within window, result sorting, minimum disclosed salary and a client-side location match
- **6 curated feeds** — best jobs, urgent hiring, featured, part-time, high-salary, headhunter/executive-search
- **63 provinces/cities and 157 job categories** available as search filters
- **Rich fields per job:** company data, salary when disclosed, skills, benefits, industries, job functions, description, geo coordinates and applicant-demand signals
- **Empty fields are omitted** — every record only contains data actually present on the listing

## Output per job

Core fields:
- `jobId` — VietnamWorks' internal listing ID
- `title`, `companyName`, `companyId`, `companyLogoUrl`, `companyUrl`, `companySize`
- `locations[]`, `locationsVi[]`, `country`, `workAddress`, `latitude`, `longitude`
- `jobLevel`, `jobLevelId` — seniority level, when VietnamWorks tags the listing
- `typeWorking`, `typeWorkingId` — employment type
- `salaryText`, `salaryMin`, `salaryMax`, `salaryCurrency` — numbers only when disclosed
- `requirementText`, `descriptionText`
- `skills[]`, `benefits[]`, `companyProfile`
- `companyIndustry`, `companyIndustries[]`, `companyIndustriesVi[]`
- `jobFunctionCategory`, `jobFunctions[]`, `jobFunctionCategoryVi`, `jobFunctionsVi[]`
- `minYearsExperience`, `numberOfRecruits`, `applicantCount`, `applicantSignal`
- `isAnonymous`, `isUrgentJob`
- `postedText`, `createdOn`, `expiredDate`, `onlineOn`
- `sourceUrl`, `recordType: "job"`, `scrapedAt`

Mode-specific fields:
- `feedType` (`trending` only) — which curated feed the job came from
- `descriptionSnippet` (`trending` only) — a ~450-character preview
- `address` (`trending` only) — the feed's free-text address
- `expiredDate` (`search` only) — ISO expiry date from the search index

Extra fields with `fetchFullDetails: true` or `mode=byUrls`:
- `workingDays`, `workingHours`
- `contactName`
- `companyProfileUrl`, `companyAddress`, `companyWebsite`, `companyImageUrls[]`
- `expiredOn` — full detail-page expiry timestamp

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | select | `trending` | `trending` / `search` / `byUrls` |
| `feedType` | select | `bestJobs` | Curated feed to pull (mode=trending): `bestJobs`, `urgentJobs`, `featuredJobs`, `partTimeJobs`, `highSalaryJobs`, `headhunterJobs` |
| `keyword` | string | `developer` | Free-text query (mode=search). Leave empty to browse all jobs that match the filters |
| `locationIds` | array (select) | – | One or more of 63 Vietnamese provinces/cities (mode=search) |
| `industryIds` | array (select) | – | One or more of 157 VietnamWorks job categories (mode=search) |
| `jobLevelIds` | array (select) | – | One or more seniority levels (mode=search) |
| `typeWorkingIds` | array (select) | – | One or more employment types (mode=search) |
| `postedWithin` | select | `any` | `any` / `24h` / `3d` / `7d` (mode=search) |
| `sortBy` | select | `relevance` | `relevance` / `newest` / `oldest` / `salaryHighToLow` (mode=search) |
| `locationContains` | string | – | Client-side filter: keep only jobs whose location text contains this |
| `minSalary` | integer | – | Drop jobs with disclosed salary below this (VND/month). USD listings are compared at an approximate 25,000 VND/USD rate; undisclosed salaries always pass |
| `fetchFullDetails` | boolean | `false` | Visit each job's detail page for employer profile links, working hours and exact address |
| `jobUrls` | array | – | VietnamWorks job listing URLs (mode=byUrls) |
| `maxItems` | integer | `30` | Hard cap on emitted records (1–500) |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | off | Optional proxy override; the actor retries blocked fetches automatically |

### Example: paginated search across all pages

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "keyword": "developer",
  "maxItems": 200
}
```

### Example: filtered search

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "keyword": "accountant",
  "locationIds": ["24"],
  "industryIds": ["13"],
  "jobLevelIds": ["5", "7"],
  "typeWorkingIds": ["1"],
  "postedWithin": "7d",
  "sortBy": "newest",
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: trending high-salary jobs in Ho Chi Minh City

```json
{
  "mode": "trending",
  "feedType": "highSalaryJobs",
  "locationContains": "Ho Chi Minh",
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: fetch specific listings

```json
{
  "mode": "byUrls",
  "jobUrls": [
    "https://www.vietnamworks.com/full-stack-developer-1794302751663017977-2129878-jv"
  ],
  "fetchFullDetails": true
}
```

## Use cases

- **Recruitment intelligence** — track live Vietnamese vacancies by category, level and location
- **Salary benchmarking** — aggregate disclosed salary bands across roles and currencies
- **Labour-market research** — analyze hiring demand by industry/city over time
- **Talent sourcing** — bulk-collect employer, skill and location data for outreach

## FAQ

**What's VietnamWorks?** Vietnam's largest job board and recruitment platform, part of Navigos Group, covering listings across every province and industry. See [vietnamworks.com](https://www.vietnamworks.com).

**Is a login or API key required?** No — all three modes use public endpoints.

**How does search pagination work?** The actor calls VietnamWorks' live search API page by page (100 hits per page) and stops when `maxItems` is reached or the source runs out of pages. Set `maxItems` to the number of jobs you need, up to 500 per run.

**Why do I get fewer rows than the site's headline count?** The upstream search index reports a total that includes promotions and expired listings that may disappear between page requests. The actor de-duplicates by job ID and stops at the source's own page count, so the dataset is a clean subset of what the site shows at that moment.

**How are salary values represented?** `salaryMin` and `salaryMax` are in the listing's own `salaryCurrency`; listings without a disclosed salary omit the numeric fields and keep `salaryText` (for example "Negotiable"). The `minSalary` filter is in VND and converts USD listings approximately for filtering only — output values are never converted.

**Why is `descriptionSnippet` truncated in `trending` mode?** The homepage feeds intentionally return a ~450-character preview. Use `mode=search` for the indexed description, or `fetchFullDetails: true` / `mode=byUrls` for the detail page.

**Why are `skills`/`benefits` sometimes missing from `byUrls` results?** VietnamWorks' detail pages are built with React Server Components. Most fields are embedded directly, but `skills` and `benefits` are occasionally streamed as nested references the actor cannot always resolve. Those fields are then omitted — never fabricated.

**How does the `locationContains` filter work?** It is a case-insensitive substring match against each job's parsed location list, applied client-side on top of any mode (including `search`'s server-side province/city filter).

**Do I need a proxy?** No. The actor works without one. If VietnamWorks blocks a request from a datacenter IP, the actor retries through its own proxy path automatically; `proxyConfiguration` is only an optional override for advanced users.

**How fresh is the data?** Real-time — every run hits VietnamWorks' live homepage, search index and detail pages directly.

**Is this affiliated with VietnamWorks?** No, this is an independent third-party actor that reads VietnamWorks' public pages. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by VietnamWorks or Navigos Group.
